Question 1
?

Consider the curve r(t)=⟨2t,1−3t,5+6t⟩, t≥0, for which the arc length s from r(0) to r(t) is given by s=7t. Find R(s), the parametrization of the curve by its arc length s.

a
 R(s)=⟨2s,7−3s,35+6s⟩
b
 R(s)=⟨2s,7+3s,35+6s⟩
c
 R(s)=17⟨2s,7−3s,35+6s⟩
d
 R(s)=17⟨2s,7+3s,35+6s⟩
e
 R(s)=17⟨2s,1−3s,5+6s⟩
Submit
